query:
SELECT l.event_hash, l.event_bytes, l.source_id
                 FROM big_repo_keyhive_event_log l
                WHERE l.scope_id = ?1
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                          FROM big_repo_keyhive_admissions a
                         WHERE a.scope_id = l.scope_id
                           AND a.event_hash = l.event_hash
                  )
                ORDER BY l.seq
